name: Arisen Aaru Sandals
description:
Osiris, a man unknown to the siblings, fled Aaru not long after Ptah's departure, for he too had grand illusions of power and glory. He travelled West, following what he thought to be Gengen-Wer's trail.

And while he did not find Gengen-Wer, he found plumes of feathers, fallen from the great bird. And where these feathers lay, the power of beasts was awakened.

Kingdoms arose. First Elysium, built upon a rift to the underworld, where Osiris was destined to rule.

And as the wind took the feathers South of here, Nothren was sure to rise.

name: Arisen Cursed Lero's Hood

name: Arisen Cursed Niskus' Boots

A jester bound to fate's dark will.
He tips his skull with courtly cheer,
And whispers names for none to hear.

Through misty moors the rider flies,
With hollow laugh and lantern eyes.
His severed head held firm and tight,
A beacon grim in candlelight.

The Dullahan rides when the moon is high,
A headless shadow against the sky.
He hums a tune both sharp and sweet,
That chills the heart with every beat.

name: Arisen Rift Legwraps
description: A piece of Judge's attire worn by Charon. When standing strong with these boots, your follower will be slightly stronger.

name: Arisen Rift Summoner Boots
description: A piece of Judge's attire worn by Charon. When standing strong with these boots, your summons will be slightly stronger.

name: Arisen Rift Summoner Helmet
description: A piece of Judge's attire worn by Charon. When wearing this helmet, using pacts with your summons will be more effective.

name: Arisen Rift Summoner Plate
description: A piece of Judge's attire worn by Charon. When wearing this armor, your summons will be more likely to protect you.

name: Arisen Riftguard Armor
description: A piece of Judge's attire worn by Rhada. When taking Ward damage while wearing this armor, one will take reduced self damage from status effects.

name: Arisen Riftguard Helmet
description: A piece of Judge's attire worn by Rhada. When taking Ward damage while wearing this armor, HP and Mana will be recovered by a percentage of the Ward damage taken.

name: Arisen Riftguard Leggings
description: A piece of Judge's attire worn by Rhada. When taking Ward damage while wearing this armor, HP and Mana will be recovered by a percentage of the Ward damage taken.

name: Arisen Riftrazor
description: Long katana carried by Judge Achlys's side. It will deal additional damage for each critical hit in a row.

name: Arisen Riftrogue Boots
description: A piece of Judge's attire worn by Achlys. One may move with extra grace when wearing this armor, decreasing your chance to miss your mark.

name: Arisen Riftrogue Chestplate
description: A piece of Judge's attire worn by Achlys. One may move with extra grace when wearing this armor, decreasing your chance to miss your mark.

name: Arisen Riftrogue Helmet
description: A piece of Judge's attire worn by Achlys. One may move with extra grace when wearing this armor, decreasing your chance to miss your mark.

name: Arisen Riftshield
description: Shield of Judge Rhada. It features two slots for adornment while providing additional resistance.

entries.name: Tower of Strength
entries.description: Recovers Ward. Requires 2 turns in battle.

name: Arisen Riftstaff
description: Staff of Charon, the Grand Summoner. It decreases one's chance to miss their mark.

name: Arisen Riftsword
description: Greatsword and Great Shield ensemble of Judge Rhada. When taking Ward damage, HP and Mana will be recovered by a percentage of the Ward damage taken.

entries.name: Rhada Stomp
entries.description: Stomp one foot down, taking a defensive position and reducing damage for 1 turn. On the next turn, deliver a powerful strike.

name: Arisen Ring
description: A ring of the arisen cursed Fafnir. Increases your attack and magic power at the expense of your longevity.

name: Arisen Robe
description: Robe worn by acolytes of Mammon, the demon of hubris.

name: Arisen Satis
description: Bow of Thronemaker Sekhmet. When holding this weapon, one will often be granted temporary dexterity or critical strike chance in battle.

name: Arisen Sea Axe
description: An axe enchanted with the power of the raging sea. It greatly increases the chance of dealing collateral damage.

name: Arisen Shadeblades
description: Daggers conjoined with a chain, carried by the Achlys, the Red Dagger. The daggers do additional damage for each critical hit in a row.

entries.name: Slice
entries.description: Deals damage and may cause bleeding. Additionally, it may hit an additional opponent.

entries.name: Shade of Achlys, the Red Dagger

name: Arisen Shield
description: A heavy shield carried by knights of Mammon, the demon of hubris. It grants one immunity to being Cursed.

entries.name: Bastion III
entries.description: Grants temporary defenses and grants Ward for 5 turns.

name: Arisen Shoes
description: Shoes worn by acolytes of Mammon, the demon of hubris.

name: Arisen Silk Crossbow
description: A sturdy crossbow fastened with a thread of strong silk.

name: Arisen Sleighblade
description: A glistening sword carried by followers of Scruug. It is quite chilling to the touch. When using this weapon, you will start battle with Ward automatically activated.

name: Arisen Spinal Whip
description:
He lifts his head as though to bow,
And tips it gently, here and now.
No crown of gold, no jeweled delight,
Just grinning teeth in ghostly white.

name: Arisen Spiritgarm Grimoire
description: Book carried by Fenja, the Nothren summoner. It can call a famed Nothren wolf into battle.

entries.name: Summon Fey Spiritgarm
entries.description: Summon an animal to assist you. Requires 2 turns in battle.

name: Arisen Staff of Tiamat
description: A superb staff forged of the remains of Tiamat, the great ancient dragon.

name: Arisen Staff of Typhon
description: A superb staff forged of the remains of Typhon, the great ancient dragon.

name: Arisen Staff of Wolves
description: Staff of a wolfman mage. Imbued with earthen powers.

name: Arisen Stone Dagger
description: A dagger, once a fixture upon a noble statue. It has a small chance of petrifying an opponent.

name: Arisen Stonewarg Grimoire
description: Book carried by Fenja, the Nothren summoner. It can call a famed Nothren wolf into battle.

entries.name: Summon Fey Stonewarg
entries.description: Summon an animal to assist you. Requires 2 turns in battle.

name: Arisen Surtr's Boots
description: Footwear of Surtr, the wanderer. They grant their wearer additional dexterity and are well suited for adornment.

name: Arisen Surtr's Cuirass
description: Light armor of Surtr, the wanderer. It grants its wearer additional Ward and is well suited for adornment.

name: Arisen Surtr's Helmet
description: Helmet of Surtr, the wanderer. It grants its wearer additional HP and is well suited for adornment.

name: Arisen Surtr's Shield
description: Decorated shield of Surtr, the Southern wanderer. It increases defense and resistance at the expense of Ward.

entries.name: Bastion III
entries.description: Grants temporary defenses and grants Ward for 5 turns.

name: Arisen Surtr's Sword
description: The extremely bright, decorative sword of Surtr. It can easily blind an opponent and will draw more monsters towards you with its bright, everlasting light.

name: Arisen Teardrop
description: A relic of Mammon capable of granting a piece of equipment additional power while occasionally lowering an opponent's attack or magical power.

name: Arisen Terror
description: An incredibly dreadful staff forged of the remains of sunken travelers. It may cause fallen beasts to drop more gold and orns.

name: Arisen Thor's Arc
description: A masterfully crafted magical bow of Thor. Thor founded the Stormforce shortly before succumbing to the power of the falling. His bow can easily paralyze an opponent.

name: Arisen Thor's Hammer
description: Small, yet immensely heavy hammer of Thor. Thor founded the Stormforce shortly before succumbing to the power of the falling. His hammer can easily paralyze an opponent.

name: Arisen Tizona
description: A greatsword often used in defensive swordplay by the almighty knight, Balin. Strikes of the sword have the ability to lower an opponent's physical or magical defenses.

entries.name: Parry
entries.description: Wait one turn, then return an opponent's attack back at them.

name: Arisen Top Hat
description: Boy, it is dapper! When wearing this hat, you can wield two-handed weapons more effectively.

name: Arisen Treecutter
description: An enormous tool carried by Gymir, a great giant. Its ability can grant one Gymir's stance, granting one additional attack power but harming oneself every turn.

entries.name: Gymir Stance
entries.description: Take the stance of Gymir, increasing your attack power, but taking damage every turn.

name: Arisen Trevelyan's Archistaff
description: Staff of Trevelyan, the storied Lyonesse Warlock. Wearing it will offer one great magical abilities, but must be held with both hands.

entries.name: Brilliant Lights II
entries.description: Unstable elementless magic that can blind an opponent while dealing damage thrice to all opponents.

name: Arisen Trevelyan's Charm
description: Amulet carried by Trevelyan, the storied Lyonesse Warlock. Wearing it will increase your offensive power when carrying a weapon with both hands.

name: Arisen Trevelyan's Hood
description: Hood of Trevelyan, the storied Lyonesse Warlock. Wearing it will slightly decrease the mana required for spells while protecting one from the arcane arts.

name: Arisen Trevelyan's Robe
description: Robe of Trevelyan, the storied Lyonesse Warlock. Wearing it will slightly decrease the mana required for spells while protecting one from the arcane arts.

name: Arisen Trevelyan's Shoes
description: Shoes of Trevelyan, the storied Lyonesse Warlock. Wearing them will slightly decrease the mana required for spells while protecting one from the arcane arts.

name: Arisen Unspeakable Tentacle
description: A severed limb from an unspeakable horror. It drowns every call but his own and everything it touches loses thought and fate.
effects: Status Effect Chance: +9% / Status Effect Duration: +1 turn

name: Arisen Vandal's Veil
description: A thick piece of fabric, often used to protect one's lungs. Wearing it makes one less likely to be afflicted with status effects.

name: Arisen Vulcan's Archistaff
description: An embered Archistaff seldom wielded by Vulcan, the Red Knight. Vulcan formed the Knights of Inferno to fight alongside the forces of Annwn. His staff can easily burn an opponent.

name: Arisen Vulcan's Longsword
description: A seemingly flawless blade wielded by Vulcan, the Red Knight. Vulcan formed the Knights of Inferno to fight alongside the forces of Annwn. His blade can easily burn an opponent.

name: Arisen Willow Branch
description: A large tree branch carried by Eistla, a great giant. Its ability can grant one Eistla's stance, doubling hybrid damage at the expense of your follower's prowess.

entries.name: Eistla Stance
entries.description: Take the stance of Eistla, greatly increasing hybrid offensive ability at the expense of your follower's prowess.

name: Arisen Witch's Hat
description: The symbolic headwear of Carman, the banished witch.

name: Arisen Witch's Scroll
description: A scroll containing knowledge of a Witch's arts. It improves one's mana at the sacrifice of Ward, while adding a chance to inflict many status effects to spells.

entries.name: Read Scroll II
entries.description: Slightly restores mana.

name: Arisen Witch's Staff
description: Old, decrepit, dark staff of a powerful witch. Slightly boosts experience earned.

name: Arisen Wolfbane
description: A magical blade representing the unrelenting force of Fenrir the wolf. It can temporarily decrease your opponent's defense upon use. Additionally, it increases the chance of dealing collateral damage.

name: Arisen Wolven Tower Shield
description: A gigantic shield often used to protect one from the wildest of wolves. It offers additional defense at the expense of power.

entries.name: Bastion III
entries.description: Grants temporary defenses and grants Ward for 5 turns.

name: Arms of Eos
description: A piece of a Titan themself. These pieces can be used to augment celestial weapons at a Titan Workshop. This piece will make pacts with your summons more effective.

name: Arms of Mnemosyne
description: Titan Mnemosyne, mother of Titans and sculptor of memories, puzzles, and labyrinths, protected her kin by misleading adventurers.

name: Arms of Oceanus
description: A piece of a Titan themself. These pieces can be used to augment celestial weapons at a Titan Workshop.

name: Arms of Prometheus
description: A piece of a Titan themself. These pieces can be used to augment celestial weapons at a Titan Workshop.

name: Arms of Selene
description: A piece of a Titan themself. These pieces can be used to augment celestial weapons at a Titan Workshop. This piece will make hybrid spells and skills more effective.

name: Arms of Themis
description: A piece of a Titan themself. These pieces can be used to augment celestial weapons at a Titan Workshop.

name: Artifice Gada
description: The crippling weapon of Knight Artifice, the dragonslayer of Avalon. It can lower an opponent's magical potential.

name: Artio's Hide
description: Bear hide armor of Artio, bear Goddess of the Fomorian house of Nocturna. Artio, of three siblings, spent her days taming wild bears. While wearing this item, you will tame your opponent's followers and summons, causing them to deal less damage to you.

name: Ascalon
description: An adorned sword forged of the most blessed of materials. It's great light can illuminate your path while blinding your opponents.

name: Asgard Armor
description: Heavy armor of Nothren valkyries.

name: Asgard Greaves
description: Heavy armor of Nothren valkyries.

name: Asgard Helmet
description: Heavy armor of Nothren valkyries.

name: Asgard Shield
description: Shield carried by valkyries of the Northern lands. It protects one from the cold.

name: Asgard's Summit
description: A rare blade carried by the most gifted of Nothren valkyries. It may grant one the stance of Gunnr, raising attack power but lowering defenses.

name: Ash-Plumed Boots
description: Footwear of a worshipper of the mighty Phoenix. Using this item may grant temporary improvements to your stats.

name: Ash-Plumed Cowl
description: Headwear of a worshipper of the mighty Phoenix. Using this item may grant temporary improvements to your stats.

name: Ash-Plumed Cuirass
description: Heavy armor of a worshipper of the mighty Phoenix. Using this item may grant temporary improvements to your stats.

name: Ash-Plumed Garb
description: Light armor of a worshipper of the mighty Phoenix. Using this item may grant temporary improvements to your stats.

name: Ash-Plumed Greaves
description: Heavy leg armor of a worshipper of the mighty Phoenix. Using this item may grant temporary improvements to your stats.

name: Ash-Plumed Helmet
description: Helmet of a worshipper of the mighty Phoenix. Using this item may grant temporary improvements to your stats.

name: Ash-Plumed Hood
description: Hood of a worshipper of the mighty Phoenix. Using this item may grant temporary improvements to your stats.

name: Ash-Plumed Robe
description: Robe of a worshipper of the mighty Phoenix. Using this item may grant temporary improvements to your stats.

name: Ash-Plumed Shoes
description: Footwear of a worshipper of the mighty Phoenix. Using this item may grant temporary improvements to your stats.

name: Ashen Boots
description: Pale attire of elite Balor mages.

name: Ashen Hat
description: Pale attire of elite Balor mages.

name: Ashen Phoenician Boots
description: Footwear of a worshipper of a fallen Phoenix. Wearing this item may occasionally protect you from status effects.

name: Ashen Phoenician Cowl
description: Headwear of a worshipper of a fallen Phoenix. Wearing this item may occasionally protect you from status effects.

name: Ashen Phoenician Cuirass
description: Heavy armor of a worshipper of a fallen Phoenix. Wearing this item may occasionally protect you from status effects.

name: Ashen Phoenician Garb
description: Light armor of a worshipper of a fallen Phoenix. Wearing this item may occasionally protect you from status effects.

name: Ashen Phoenician Greaves
description: Heavy leg armor of a worshipper of a fallen Phoenix. Wearing this item may occasionally protect you from status effects.

name: Ashen Phoenician Helmet
description: Helmet of a worshipper of a fallen Phoenix. Wearing this item may occasionally protect you from status effects.

name: Ashen Phoenician Hood
description: Hood of a worshipper of a fallen Phoenix. Wearing this item may occasionally protect you from status effects.

name: Ashen Phoenician Robe
description: Robe of a worshipper of a fallen Phoenix. Wearing this item may occasionally protect you from status effects.

name: Ashen Phoenician Shield
description: Decorated shield of a worshipper of a fallen Phoenix. It protects one from being blinded and may occasionally protect you from other status effects.

entries.description: Grants temporary defenses and grants Ward for 5 turns.

name: Ashen Phoenician Shoes
description: Footwear of a worshipper of a fallen Phoenix. Wearing this item may occasionally protect you from status effects.

name: Ashen Pinion
description: A feather pulled from the remains of a fallen Phoenix.

name: Ashen Robe
description: Pale attire of elite Balor mages.

name: Ashen Ruby
description: A jewel with a crimson glow. Adorning this upon a weapon will slightly heal your wounds when damaging an opponent.

name: Ashen Staff
description: A pale staff granted to skilled Balor mages.

name: Askr Armor
description: Heavy armor of a sapling of Yggdrasil, the fallen symbol of life. Wearing it may occasionally greatly increase one's power.

name: Askr Boots
description: Boots of a sapling of Yggdrasil, the fallen symbol of life. Wearing them will keep one from becoming stunned.

name: Askr Cowl
description: Cowl of a sapling of Yggdrasil, the fallen symbol of life. Wearing it may decrease the damage you may inflict upon yourself.

name: Askr Garb
description: Garb of a sapling of Yggdrasil, the fallen symbol of life. Wearing it may occasionally greatly increase one's power.

name: Askr Helmet
description: Helmet of a sapling of Yggdrasil, the fallen symbol of life. Wearing it may decrease the damage you may inflict upon yourself.

name: Askr Leggings
description: Heavy leggings of a sapling of Yggdrasil, the fallen symbol of life. Wearing them will keep one from becoming stunned.

name: Assassin's Jewel
description: An adornment of assassins. When adorned upon a weapon, it grants the chance to inflict damage to an opponent's defenses.

name: Astralseed
description: A seed to expand one's Astraltree. Use them at the Astraltree to unlock various rewards. Astraltrees reset each week.

name: Atepomarus Mail
description: Heavy armor of Atepomarus, horse God and leader of the Fomorian house of Nocturna. Atepomarus, father to the three siblings, was set to ride three horses at once into battle. While wearing this item, you will tame your opponent's followers and summons, causing them to deal less damage to you.

name: Atgeir
description: A deadly polearm carried by the fallen Heimdall, a lord of the Nothren.

name: Atlas
description: Shield of a fallen Lyonesse Vanguard.

entries.name: Bastion III
entries.description: Grants temporary defenses and grants Ward for 5 turns.

name: Attack Tonic
description: A sour tonic that raises your attack in battle.

name: Attuning Hood
description: Hood worn by novice summoners. It slightly increases the power of summoned beasts.

name: Attuning Robe
description: Robe worn by novice summoners. It increases the chance of a summon protecting you in battle.

name: Attuning Shoes
description: Shoes worn by novice summoners.

name: Autumna Crested Shield
description: Shield of Fomor, Cursed King of Fomoria. This item grants a number of passive abilities known to be utilized by the Fomorian houses.
effects: Status Effect Chance: +21% / Status Effect Duration: +1 turn

name: Avalon Crown
description: The fabled crown of King Arthus. Although it offers little in terms of defense, it can protect its wearer from being cursed or petrified.

name: Avalon Knight Armor
description: Heavy armor of prestigious Avalon knights.

name: Avalon Knight Helmet
description: Heavy armor of prestigious Avalon knights.

name: Avalon Knight Leggings
description: Heavy armor of prestigious Avalon knights.

name: Avalon Melody
description: Famed golden flute of an Avalon bard. Playing its songs can temporarily raise one's magical defense.

name: Avalon Ore
description: A mighty alloy. It was used to craft Avalonian weapons and armor.

name: Axe
description: A woodcutter's axe. Useful as a tool or as a weapon.

name: Axe of Gilgamesh
description: Heavy axe of the Gilgamesh.

name: Axe of Night
description: An axe wielded by monsters of the night. Enhanced with dark magic. It greatly increases the chance of dealing collateral damage.

name: Axe of the Chimera
description: A powerful axe forged of the remains of a Chimera. Using this weapon may cause one to fill with immense rage, inflicting the Berserk status. Additionally, it increases collateral damage dealt and the chance of dealing collateral damage.

name: Axe of Tiamat
description: A powerful axe forged of the remains of Tiamat, the great ancient dragon. It increases collateral damage dealt.

name: Axe of Typhon
description: A powerful axe forged of the remains of Typhon, the great ancient dragon. It increases the chance of dealing collateral damage.

name: Azure Carp
description: A small fish.

name: Azure Crystal
description: An azure crystal of the night. Increases magical ability at the expense of physical prowess.

name: Azure Dioscuri Ring
description: The ring of a fused Dioscuri. It grants additional offensive power to those that prefer a more hybrid approach to combat.

name: Azure Pinion
description: A feather pulled from the remains of a cursed Cockatrice. It grants additional magic power at the expense of magical resistance and mana.

name: Azure Twinbow
description: The Twinbow of a fused Dioscuri. It grants additional offensive power to those that prefer a more hybrid approach to combat.

name: Badb Boots
description: Cursed legwear of a follower of Badb, the great witch.

name: Badb Catha
description: Cursed greatbow of Badb, sister to Morrigan. It can grant one additional dexterity while having the adverse effect on an opponent.
effects: Status Effect Chance: +12% / Status Effect Duration: +1 turn

name: Badb Garb
description: Cursed light armor of a follower of Badb, the great witch.

name: Badb Veil
description: Cursed headwear of a follower of Badb, the great witch.

name: Badb Warbow
description: Cursed greatbow of Badb, sister to Morrigan. It can grant one additional dexterity while having the adverse effect on an opponent.

name: Badb's Feathers
description: A quiver of arrows carried by Badb, the rogue witch. Carrying them will increase both attack power and dexterity, while potentially poisoning or causing an opponent to rot.

entries.name: Volley II
entries.description: Deals damage thrice, grants 2 turns of Ward, and may temporarily increase dexterity.

name: Bag of Treats
description: A bag of treats of lore and luck. Carrying it increases gold, orns, and experience earned. You may also find more items.

name: Bag of Tricks
description: A bag of tricks of lore and luck. Carrying it may add the chance for many status effects to your attacks and spells.

name: Baguette de Clarent
description: Few know that Clarent's bakery is a pride and joy of Elysium. When carrying this loaf of bread by one's side, it is easy to recover from what ails us in battle.

name: Balanced Epee
description: The blademaster Finesse is known for carrying an inhuman amount of swords upon his back. This epee is one of them.

name: Baldr Battlerobe
description: War-mage's robe of Baldr, the undying. Wearing this item will increase HP while making one slightly more resistant to status effects.

name: Baldr Boots
description: War-mage's boots of Baldr, the undying. Wearing this item will increase HP while making one slightly more resistant to status effects.

name: Baldr Hood
description: War-mage's hood of Baldr, the undying. Wearing this item will increase HP while making one slightly more resistant to status effects.

name: Baldur
description: A chunk of Baldur, favored by the raiders of Nothren.

name: Balin's Left
description: A heavy great sword carried in Sir Balin's left hand. A blow from this blade can lower an opponent's magic power when attacking.

name: Balin's Left
description: A heavy great sword carried in Sir Balin's left hand. A blow from this blade can lower an opponent's magic power.

name: Balin's Right
description: A heavy great sword carried in Sir Balin's right hand. A blow from this blade can lower an opponent's attack power.

name: Balor Archistaff
description: Staff wielded by Balor mages. It increases mana at the expense of health.

name: Balor Armor
description: Heavy armor typically worn by Balor warriors.

name: Balor Crown
description: The fabled crown of King Balor.

name: Balor Dagger
description: Dagger often carried as a sidearm by demon soldiers. Has the chance of both burning and causing an opponent to bleed.

name: Balor Helmet
description: A heavy helmet typically worn by Balor warriors.

name: Balor Katana
description: Katana wielded by Balor rogues. It has a high chance of causing an opponent to bleed.

name: Balor Leggings
description: Heavy leggings typically worn by Balor warriors.

name: Balor Memory
description: Fragment of the collective consciousness of those associated with Apollyon, the exiled mystic. Perhaps we can find use of this item at the Monumental Guild.

name: Balor Mnemonic
description: Mnemonic crafted by the Monumental Guild using distorted memories of Balor. Use it to bring forth a distorted memory of Apollyon.

name: Balor Muskellunge
description: Quite a rare fish, seemingly ascended from the Underworld.

name: Balor Robe
description: A dark, dusty robe typically worn by Balor mages.

name: Balor Shield
description: A decorated shield often carried by Balor warriors.

name: Balor Sword
description: A commonly used sword of knights of Balor.

name: Balorite
description: A golden material useful in upgrading powerful equipment.

name: Band of False Gods
description: A ring worn by the elemental Gods of old. Increases gold, orns, and experience earned.

name: Band of Gods
description: A ring worn by the elemental Gods of old. Increases gold, orns, and experience earned.

name: Band of Mnemosyne
description: Titan Mnemosyne, mother of Titans and sculptor of memories, puzzles, and labyrinths, protected her kin by misleading adventurers.

name: Bandit's Axe
description: A large axe carried by the mightiest bandits.

name: Bandit's Cloak
description: Heavy cloak of a bandit. Offers mild defense against the elements.

name: Bandit's Dagger
description: A small blade ideal for close quartered combat. It slightly increases dexterity.

name: Bandit's Hood
description: Heavy hood made of strong hide. Offers mild protection against the elements.

name: Baneblade
description: Ceremonial blade of a long forgotten civilization. It has a small chance of cursing an opponent.

name: Banhammer
description: Gear of the community hero.

name: Banshee Boots
description: Cursed legwear of a follower of Morrigan, the great witch.

name: Banshee Robe
description: Cursed robe of a follower of Morrigan, the great witch.

name: Banshee Veil
description: Cursed headwear of a follower of Morrigan, the great witch.

name: Basilisk Talons
description: A pair of dark kunai, forged of a basilisk's claws.

name: Basilisk Tooth
description: Thin sword forged of Basilisk remains. It has a chance to cause either poison or blight.

name: Battle Axe
description: A large, crushing axe.

name: Battlemage Armor
description: Some magic users are also skilled in combat. This is the armor of one.

name: Battlemage Boots
description: Some magic users are also skilled in combat. These are the boots of one.

name: Battlemage Helmet
description: Some magic users are also skilled in combat. This is the helmet of one.

name: Batwing Bow
description: Bow forged of a great bat's remains. It may break an opponent's defenses.

name: Beag's Lute
description: A small weapon carried by a Clurichaun. Although it is not suitable for your primary hand, it will fit as an obscure off-hand.

entries.name: Anthem
entries.description: Potentially boost attack, magic, defenses, and resistance while potentially decreasing opponent stats.

name: Bearclaw
description: A crude blade forged of the remains of a bear.

name: Beard Bristle
description: Gear of The Creator.

name: Bearskin
description: Armor made of the hide of a bear.

name: Beast's Blood
description: A simple concoction. Consuming it may attract extra monsters to you.

name: Beastfelled Boots
description: Shoes of Lyncus, the turned Annwn King. It grants one's followers and summons the ability to use the spell "Ward of Ortanite".

name: Beastfelled Cowl
description: Armor made from the hide of a Manticore. It grants one's followers and summons the ability to use the spell "Barrier".

name: Beastfelled Cuirass
description: Robe of Lyncus, the turned Annwn King. It grants one's followers and summons the ability to use the spell "Sharpen".

name: Beastfelled Dungeon Key
description: A key that can allow one to run any Dungeon as a "Beastfelled Dungeon" during the Beastfelled event.

name: Beastfelled Garb
description: Robe of Lyncus, the turned Annwn King. It grants one's followers and summons the ability to use the spell "Berserk".

name: Beastfelled Helmet
description: Armor made from the hide of a Manticore. It grants one's followers and summons the ability to use the spell "Barrier".

name: Beastfelled Hood
description: Armor made from the hide of a Manticore. It grants one's followers and summons the ability to use the spell "Barrier".

name: Beastfelled Leggings
description: Shoes of Lyncus, the turned Annwn King. It grants one's followers and summons the ability to use the spell "Ward of Ortanite".

name: Beastfelled Robe
description: Robe of Lyncus, the turned Annwn King. It grants one's followers and summons the ability to use the spell "Ponder".

name: Beastfelled Shoes
description: Shoes of Lyncus, the turned Annwn King. It grants one's followers and summons the ability to use the spell "Ward of Ortanite".

name: Beastfelled Summoning Scroll
description: A piece of literature crafted by the Monumental Guild. It recalls the story of Lyncus, and will summon a projection of him when read.

name: Beastly Monster Aspect
description: Aspect of a monster that one may have encountered while traveling these lands. Aspects can be charged simply by walking after being slotted in your Traveler's Guild menu. Fully charged Aspects are converted into Manifestations for use in Guild Trials. This aspect will produce Animal manifests.

name: Beatrice's Staff
description: The staff of the aspiring sorceress, Beatrice. It slightly boosts its wielder's mana.

name: Bedsheet
description: A simple white sheet that one could use to mock a spirit. It protects one from falling asleep in battle.

name: Beguiled Armor
description: A piece threaded of distant memories. Memories of the famed, yet feared, "Angel" of destruction. In his youth, Apollyon favored vitality and dexterity over orthodox defenses.

name: Beguiled Armor X

name: Beheaded Assassin's Bladed Boots
description:
His cloak is stitched from midnight's thread,
A riddle's crown upon his head.

name: Beheaded Benefactor's Pumpkinhead
description:
He trades no gold, nor silver key,
Just laughter laced with misery.

name: Beheaded Charmer's Lute
description:
For should you hear hooves drawing near.
Don’t peek outside. He likes that, dear.

name: Beheaded Duelist's Chausses
description:
He laughs through teeth that chatter cold,
A jester grim from stories old.

name: Beheaded High Cleric's Ankh
description:
Across the bridge, through mist and moor,
He knocks with silence at your door.

name: Beheaded Merchant's Tunic
description:
Yet still he hums a jaunty tune,
Beneath the glow of a fickle moon.

name: Beheaded Scholar's Chargeblade
description:
No eyes to see, yet all behold,
The rider grim with tales of old.

name: Beheaded Seeker's Glasses
description:
A lonely candle lights the way,
Where moonlit shadows twist and sway.

name: Beheaded Stargazer's Candlehead
description:
Head tucked tight beneath his arm,
He rides through night with ghostly charm.

name: Beheaded Swashbuckler's Jacket
description:
The Dullahan rides with a lantern grin,
His severed head tucked snug within.

name: Beheaded Trickster's Pumpkinhead
description:
A pumpkin grin? No, something darker,
A whispered curse, a soul's last marker.
effects: Status Effect Chance: +20% / Status Effect Duration: +1 turn

name: Beheaded Warden's Tower Shield
description:
A frightful sight, yet oddly spry,
A ghost who winks as he passes by.

name: Beheaded Zwei-fencer's Cuirass
description:
Horses snort sparks, their hooves strike flame,
He calls no soul, yet whispers your name.

name: Beithir's Staff
description: Aside: As Illuyanka's walls were raised, protection for this new land was needed. Beithir, with the breath of lightning and claws of toxin, replicated itself indefinitely. An army of Dragons was created in an instant.

entries.name: Summon Beithir
entries.description: Summon a great beast to assist you. Requires 3 turns in battle.

name: Belenus's Boots
description: Boots worn by Belenus, healing God of the Fomorian house of Nocturna. Belenus, of three siblings, spent his days attending the sick animals of Fomoria's fields. While wearing this item, you will tame your opponent's followers and summons, causing them to deal less damage to you.

name: Belt
description: A standard belt. Improves your dexterity.

name: Belt of Cerus
description: Enchanted belt of Cerus, the untamed. It protects one from burning while granting additional HP.

name: Beowulf's Charm
description: Amulet often carried by the Beowulf. Wearing this item greatly increases the power of your follower,  may cause them to act less often.

name: Berserk Mushroom
description: A mushroom of unknown origin. Eating it will cause one to enrage.

name: Bestial Eye
description: Red eye of the Behemoth. Adorning it upon a weapon will increase the action rate and stats of your follower.

name: Bestial Potion
description: A sweet and nutritious tonic. Having your follower consume it will increase their action rate for a limited time.

name: Beta Myrddin
description: One of the notoriously recognizable archistaves of Merlin, the famed Avalon sorcerer. Spells cast by this staff can occasionally lower an opponent's defenses.

name: Beta Myrddin Cloak
description: One of the notoriously recognizable robes of Merlin, the famed Avalon sorcerer. It can protect its wearer from having their resistance lowered.

name: Beta Myrddin Cowl
description: One of the notoriously recognizable hoods of Merlin, the famed Avalon sorcerer.

name: Beta Myrddin Hood
description: One of the notoriously recognizable hoods of Merlin, the famed Avalon sorcerer.

name: Beta Myrddin Robe
description: One of the notoriously recognizable robes of Merlin, the famed Avalon sorcerer. It can protect its wearer from having their resistance lowered.

name: Beta Myrddin Shield
description: A relic of Merlin's eccentric collection.

name: Bident
description: A mighty pole-arm carried by Hades, the exiled guardian of the underworld.

name: Bird Whistle
description: A simple whistle useful for calling birds from trees.

name: Black Dragon Armor
description: Armor forged of the remains of the great dragon, Fafnir.

name: Black Dragon Greaves
description: Leg armor forged of the remains of the great dragon, Fafnir.

name: Black Dragon Helmet
description: Helmet forged of the remains of the great dragon, Fafnir.

name: Black Witch Staff
description: Old, decrepit, dark staff of a powerful witch. Slightly boosts experience earned.

name: Blackened Eye of Kerberos
description: Crystallized eye of the Kerberos. It can grant a weapon additional properties when adorned upon it.

name: Bladeless
description: A strange sword, with the hilt of the Aglovale and a phantom blade.

entries.name: Aglostrike III
entries.description: Strike hard with arcane magic with the chance to hit two additional targets. This skill will use either your magic or attack stat, depending on which is greater.

name: Blessed Rune Armor
description: Mystical armor that boasts higher magic defense.

name: Blessed Rune Helmet
description: Mystical armor that boasts higher magic defense.

name: Blessed Rune Leggings
description: Mystical armor that boasts higher magic defense.

name: Blight Arrows
description: A quiver of arrows that are imbued with dragonic powers. Carrying these arrows in your off-hand gives the chance to blight an opponent, at the expense of Ward.

entries.name: Volley II
entries.description: Deals damage thrice, grants 2 turns of Ward, and may temporarily increase dexterity.

name: Blight Pendant
description: A pendant often worn by dragoons. It protects its wearer from blight.

name: Blinders
description: Blinders often used to quell a wild horse's restlessness. They increase dexterity and critical hit rate of those granted with extra concentration.

name: Blood Sword
description: A fiery red blade used by the Fomorians.

entries.name: Chaos Rift
entries.description: Chaos Rift will summon 2 of the following at random: Balor Assassin, Balor Warlock, Balor Marauder

name: Bloodwarg Grimoire
description: Book carried by Fenja, the Nothren summoner. It can call a famed Nothren wolf into battle.

entries.name: Summon Bloodwarg
entries.description: Summon an animal to assist you. Requires 2 turns in battle.

name: Blue Crystal
description: An odd blue crystal. Boosts MP when equipped.

name: Blue Dagger
description: A small blade ideal for close quartered combat. This one in particular is imbued with ice.

name: Blue Eye of Kerberos
description: Crystallized eye of the Kerberos. It grants a high chance to cause an opponent to freeze.

name: Blue Feather
description: The feather of a Zu. It can grant a piece of armor additional dexterity when adorned upon it.

name: Blue Gem
description: An odd blue gem. Raises MP when equipped.

name: Blue Wand
description: A wand for casting magic. This one in particular is imbued with ice.

name: Bolt
description: A spear of a Stormforce warrior. Very few can wield this weapon without feeling a great shock.

name: Bone
description: A fragment of sturdy bone. Useful for crafting and upgrading weapons or armor.

name: Bone Shield
description: A shield made of hardened monster bone.

entries.name: Bastion
entries.description: Grants temporary defenses and grants Ward for 3 turns.

name: Bonecrusher
description: A terribly frightening axe, seemingly forged with the hardened bones of an undead. It has a great chance of stunning an opponent. Additionally, it increases collateral damage dealt.

name: Bonesong
description: An instrument of a long fallen Odok warrior. Its song has the rare chance to temporarily boost one's critical hit rate.

name: Book of Darkness
description: A book carried by a Student of Apollyon. Before being beguiled with destructive magics, Apollyon studied the elven ways of elemental balance. These books contain great elemental affinity.

description: A book carried by a Student of Apollyon. Before being beguiled with destructive magics, Apollyon studied the elven ways of elemental balance. These books contain great elemental affinity.

name: Boots of Earth
description: Boots of a mage who controlled the ground below. Grants protection from earthen magic.

name: Boots of Fire
description: Boots of a mage who controlled the heat. Grants protection from fire.

name: Boots of Storm
description: Boots of a mage who controlled the skies. Grants protection from lightning.

name: Boots of the Sea
description: Boots of a mage who controlled the tides. Grants protection from water & ice.

name: Boots of Wolves
description: Boots of a wolfman.

name: Boreal's Staff
description: Chilling staff of Boreal, a Frozenguard elite. It has a high chance of freezing an opponent.

name: Bormana's Mantle
description: Light armor of Bormana, warrior water Goddess of the Fomorian house of Sumner. Bormana tended the Sumner crops with castle-sized barrels of water, a true testament to her strength. While wearing this item, skills that target multiple opponents will deal additional damage. Additionally, skills will seldomly hit more than one opponent.

name: Boulderbold
description: Earthen polearm of Boulder, the Earthen Legion elite. It has a high chance of stunning an opponent.

name: Bow
description: A hunter's bow.

name: Bow of Diana
description: Silver bow of a legendary huntress. It grants its wielder extra dexterity.

name: Bow of Scales
description: Although the Lizarr seemed untrained in advanced weaponry, these fine bows have been found within their settlements. This bow is enchanted with the power of ice and water.

name: Bow of the Chimera
description: A powerful bow forged of the remains of a Chimera. Using this weapon may cause one to fill with immense rage, inflicting the Berserk status.

name: Bow of Tiamat
description: A superb bow forged of the remains of Tiamat, the great ancient dragon.

name: Bow of Typhon
description: A superb bow forged of the remains of Typhon, the great ancient dragon.

name: Branch of Yggdrasil
description: A branch of Yggdrasil.

name: Bricriu's Bow
description: A small weapon carried by a Clurichaun. Although it is not suitable for your primary hand, it will fit as an obscure off-hand.

entries.name: Arrowstorm
entries.description: Bombard all opponents with many arrows.

name: Brilliant Feathers
description: Chapter IX: Quetzalcoatl flew high, shedding her feathers in the air. As the sun melted her feathers, they filled the craters Bashe left behind, forming our lakes and rivers. Her remaining feathers form this scythe, and it will better align you with your faction's might.

entries.name: Slice
entries.description: Deals damage and may cause bleeding. Additionally, it may hit an additional opponent.

name: Briny Pendant
description: A pendant found within wreckage, deep within the sea. It protects its wearer from blight, poison, rot, and toxic.

name: Broadsword
description: A sword with a wide blade.

name: Broceliande Candle
description: A candle crafted by the Monumental Guild. By lighting it, you may summon a new follower.

name: Broken Half Locket
description: Half of an old locket. It appears to be broken.

name: Broken Heart
description: Broken heart of an Elysian soul. Trade it in at the Monumental Guild during the "Menders of Hearts" event for unique rewards.

name: Broken Statue
description: A broken piece of a statue. It may be useful in upgrading rarer weapons.

name: Bronze Medal
description: Medal awarded in the Sumner Games, a storied event of Olympia.

name: Brunor's Cabochon
description: A polished gem often adorned upon Arthus's knights' weapons.
effects: Status Effect Chance: +2% / Status Effect Duration: +1 turn

name: Brynja
description: Armor of Yggdrasil, the fallen symbol of life. When wearing this armor, there is a chance one's Apex meter will not be depleted upon using an Apex ability.

name: Buckler
description: A simple buckler.

name: Bull's Eye
description: A celestial adornment capable of increasing many attributes of a piece of equipment when adorned upon it.

name: Bulwark
description: Armor forged of the remains of the dragon Nidhogg. Contrary to its size, it is of little weight and can be worn by anyone. It grants one great resistance from Dragon magic, while boosting the strength of one's own.

name: Caladbolg
description: A blade with the power to cleave the tops from the hills. It may paralyze an opponent, while protecting its wielder from paralyzation.

name: Calloused Hands of Oceanus
description: A piece of a Titan themself. These pieces can be used to augment celestial weapons at a Titan Workshop.

name: Candle-pike
description: This pike of Pyre is eternally lit. Has a very high chance of causing an opponent to burn.

name: Candle-staff
description: This staff of Pyre is eternally lit. Has a very high chance of causing an opponent to burn.

name: Candy Cane
description: A vibrant cane carried by followers of Scruug. Some say it is even pleasing to the taste. Carrying it will allow you to recover missing HP per turn.

name: Candy of Clarity
description: It's unclear what this candy does.

name: Cane
description: A wise mage's cane.

name: Canon Waystone
description: A stone imbued with the most helpful of magic. Use it to set a compass marker to story quest monster locations.

name: Caoranach's Lair Key
description: A key that can allow one to run any Dungeon as a "Caoranach's Lair" during The Cursed Queens event.

name: Carl's Dagger
description: A simple yet sentimental dagger of the aloof one, Carl.

name: Carl's Ring
description: Iron ring of the aloof one, Carl. Slightly raises some stats.

name: Carl's Ring
description: Iron ring of the aloof one, Carl. Slightly raises some stats.

name: Carnwennan
description: A mythical dagger said to have the magical power to shroud its user in shadow. It may lull an opponent to sleep.

name: Caroling Lute
description: A song is best sung with cheer.

name: Carving Stone
description: A soft and malleable stone used for generations to sculpt, carve, and write messages and art for others to enjoy. Carving Stones can be used at Settlements to leave messages for other players.

name: Castor's Archistaff
description: Azure staff of Castor, the Dioscuri magician. Castor and his twin brother seldomly leave the depths of the seas unless truly lacking in other hobbies.

name: Cat's Paw
description: For 1 hour, a 9% chance is granted to survive a hit that would have made one fall in battle.

name: Caticatona Cuirass
description: Large heavy armor of Caticatona, leader of the Fomorian house of Sumner. Caticatona, the armored Water Goddess, stood tall against Morrigan's acolytes, but ultimately fell by their staff and sword. While wearing this item, skills that target multiple opponents will deal additional damage. Additionally, skills will seldomly hit more than one opponent.

name: Caturix's Robe
description: Heavy, armored, robe of Caturix, war God and leader of the Fomorian house of Wintara. Caturix fought Morrigan to the bitter end, ultimately succumbing to the curse in battle. While wearing this item, buffs cast by its wearer may transfer to a party mate. Additionally, positive status effects will last longer.

name: Cavestone
description: Stone mined from an eerie cave. Useful for upgrading powerful weapons.

name: Celestial Archistaff
description: An extremely malleable yet durable weapon, constructed of refined Skyshards. With great vises, a Titan can augment it to fit your needs.

name: Celestial Axe
description: An extremely malleable yet durable weapon, constructed of refined Skyshards. With great vises, a Titan can augment it to fit your needs.

name: Celestial Moondrop
description: A celestial essence fallen from the skies above. Consuming it will recollect stories of the Giants and Titans, summoning a Titan to your area.

description: An extremely malleable yet durable weapon, constructed of refined Skyshards. With great vises, a Titan can augment it to fit your needs.

description: An extremely malleable yet durable weapon, constructed of refined Skyshards. With great vises, a Titan can augment it to fit your needs.

name: Chained Shadeblades
description: Daggers conjoined with a chain, carried by the Achlys, the Red Dagger. The daggers do additional damage for each critical hit in a row.

description: Chapter VI: Illuyanka then raised walls of stone to frame this new land from the raging seas and winds. The cliffs and shores can be seen from afar, and her mighty armor will surely make one feel as they are made of the cliffs themselves. It will occasionally protect you from hits that take 100% of your maximum HP.

Clota and her sisters traversed the riverways, tunnels, and creeks to get the edge in battle, but Morrigan's forces were far too plentiful. While wearing this item, debuffs will be easier to cast on your opponent. Additionally, it increases the maximum damage of status effects on your opponent.

Naxos, a dubious political figure, took it upon himself to lay claim to a new throne of Aaru, corrupting its royal halls. Without a strong and noble leader, Aaru fell and Naxos ate the souls of his fallen people, becoming a beast himself.

Does he still sing of conquest, we wonder? While wearing this item, you will tame your opponent's followers and summons, causing them to deal less damage to you.

name: Emerald Trout
description: A green-hued fish, slightly rarer than what one would usually see.

name: Emperor's Crownguard
description: A simple Crownguard for use by the Conqueror's Guild. Crownguards provide your character with added power when defending Settlements from other players. They may also prevent NPCs of the Conqueror's Guild from challenging you for your Settlements. This Crownguard will give you a great power boost for 24 hours.

name: Enchanted Skull
description: A skull enchanted with strange magic. Attracts more monsters to you when carried.

name: Endbringer
description: A large unrefined blade of giant warriors.

entries.name: Upward Strike
entries.description: Defend for 1 turn and then attack with both hands gripped tightly, dealing paltry to immense damage with the chance to hit an additional target.

name: Endless Treats
description:
So mind the road where shadows play,
For Dullahan may pass your way.
He brings no gold, no curse, no plea,
Just riddles whispered eerily.

name: Eostre's Circlet
description: Circlet of Eostre, warrior Goddess of the Fomorian house of Sumner. Eostre protected the fields and crops of Fomoria; crops that would ultimately grow the vessels of Fomoria's curse. While wearing this item, skills that target multiple opponents will deal additional damage. Additionally, skills will seldomly hit more than one opponent.

name: Essence of Aries
description: Essence of Aries, the forest goat. The Monumental Guild can combine essences with Summoning Scrolls to produce Crimson Summoning Scrolls, but only during the Crimson Festival.

name: Essence of Cerus
description: Essence of Cerus, the Untamed Bull. The Monumental Guild can combine essences with Summoning Scrolls to produce Crimson Summoning Scrolls, but only during the Crimson Festival.

name: Essence of Perseus
description: Essence of Perseus, the Gorgon Slayer. The Monumental Guild can combine essences with Summoning Scrolls to produce Crimson Summoning Scrolls, but only during the Crimson Festival.

name: Estoc
description: A simple straight sword, useful for sparring. It has a great chance at catching an opponent off guard.

name: Esus's Pillar
description: Second staff of Esus, Stone God of the Fomorian house of Wintara. Esus constructed the mighty pillars of Fomoria, an architectural delight, truly. While wearing this item, buffs cast by its wearer may transfer to a party mate. Additionally, positive status effects will last longer.

name: Everlasting Torch
description: A torch, carried in one's off-hand. It increases your sight, prevents blindness, and may cause an opponent to light aflame in battle.

entries.name: Burn
entries.description: Sets an opponent ablaze.

name: Excalibur
description: The infamous blade presented to Arthus by the Lady of the Lake.

name: EXP Potion
description: A sour tasting elixir that doubles experience earned for 1 hour.

name: Explorer's Waystone
description: A stone imbued with the most curious of magic. Using it may guide you to something interesting.

name: Fail-not

name: Falchion

name: Final Decree
description:
Osiris, a man unknown to the siblings, fled Aaru not long after Ptah's departure, for he too had grand illusions of power and glory. He travelled West, following what he thought to be Gengen-Wer's trail.

And while he did not find Gengen-Wer, he found plumes of feathers, fallen from the great bird. And where these feathers lay, the power of beasts was awakened.

Kingdoms arose. First Elysium, built upon a rift to the underworld, where Osiris was destined to rule.

And as the wind took the feathers South of here, Nothren was sure to rise.

description: Crystallized eye of the Kerberos. It grants a high chance to cause an opponent to rot.

name: Green Feather
description: The feather of a Buzzard. It can grant a piece of armor additional dexterity when adorned upon it.

name: Green Gem
description: An odd green gem. Raises magic power when equipped.

name: Griffin Crested Shield
description: A shield crested with the image of a Griffin. It protects one against Dragon attacks while boosting Ward.

name: Grioarvolr
description: A staff that brings down giants. It may break an opponents magical defenses.

name: Grotesque Monster Aspect
description: Aspect of a monster that one may have encountered while traveling these lands. Aspects can be charged simply by walking after being slotted in your Traveler's Guild menu. Fully charged Aspects are converted into Manifestations for use in Guild Trials. This aspect will produce Goblin, Orc, or Giant manifests.

name: Guinevere's Hairpin
description:
Pristine jewelry of Queen Guinevere. Guinevere was seemingly immune to the enrapturing allure of Nimue's vast sea, which made her the favored prey of the most vicious of beasts.

Thus, she avoided the coasts and fled to the mountains, living the life of a recluse.

name: Gungnir
description: A mighty spear forged by dwarves for the great Nothren god, Odin. This spear can easily pierce an opponent's defenses, but must be wielded with both hands. Additionally, it increases the collateral damage dealt.

entries.name: Impale
entries.description: Attack with your weapon extended, dealing moderate damage but mitigating damage from your opponent's next attack.

name: Halberd
description: An axe blade atop a long pole. Useful for keeping distance while striking.

name: Hallowed Blade
description: A replica of Pumpkinhead's original sword. Aglovale, now know as Pumpkinhead, was enraptured in strange, but seasonal, magicks. Ultimately, this led him to insanity, now donning a pumpkin atop his mangled face.

entries.name: Aglostrike
entries.description: Strike hard with arcane magic with the chance to hit an additional target. This skill will use either your magic or attack stat, depending on which is greater.

name: Hallowed Candle
description: When lit, this mysterious candle draws stronger enemies to you for 1 hour. Monsters defeated with this candle lit also give more experience.

name: Hallowed Crucible
description: An crucible holding the remains of Pumpkinless. Use it upon an Anguished item to receive a bonus unique to this item.

name: Hallowed Monster Tome
description: A large tome of monster knowledge. Increases experience earned.

name: Hallowed Summoning Scroll
description: A scroll to summon something strange.

name: Hallowed Witch's Hat
description: The symbolic headwear of a nameless witch. It can protect one from status effects caused by the four basic elements.

name: Hamfarir
description: Robes of Yggdrasil, the fallen symbol of life. When wearing this item, there is a chance one's Manaflask will not be emptied upon using an Manaflask or Bloodflask spell.

name: Hammer
description: A large hammer suitable for crushing blows.

name: Hands of Mnemosyne
description:
The Olympians constructed many great Titans to construct their towers to the skies. Few titans remain animated today.

Titan Mnemosyne, mother of Titans and sculptor of memories, puzzles, and labyrinths, protected her kin by misleading adventurers.

name: Handy Waystone
description: A stone imbued with the most helpful of magic. Use it to set a compass marker to inn quest monster locations.

name: Hard Leather Armor
description: Light armor reinforced with hardened leather. Offers fair protection from the elements.

name: Hard Leather Boots
description: Sturdy leather boots. Offers extra protection.

name: Hardened Steel
description: Steel, yet seemingly more durable than usual. Useful in upgrading stronger weapons.

name: Hardwood Lute
description: A talented bard's lute, playing it in battle may temporarily boost one's defenses.

name: Harpy's Feathers
description: Crude armor made of the remains of a harpy. Does not offer much defense, but raises your dexterity.

name: Haunted Calling Bell
description:
So when the winds grow sharp and thin,
And night pulls tighter round your skin,
Take heed, take care, and hush your breath,
For Dullahan rides the roads of death.

name: Haunted Dullahan Bladed Boots
description:
He bows with grace, though crownless still,
A jester bound to fate's dark will.
He tips his skull with courtly cheer,
And whispers names for none to hear.

name: Haunted Dullahan Cloak
description:
Through misty moors the rider flies,
With hollow laugh and lantern eyes.
His severed head held firm and tight,
A beacon grim in candlelight.

name: Haunted Dullahan Skull
description:
The Dullahan rides when the moon is high,
A headless shadow against the sky.
He hums a tune both sharp and sweet,
That chills the heart with every beat.

entries.name: Wail II
entries.description: A shrill wail.

description: Gear of the giant knight.

name: Havel's Helmet
description: Gear of the giant knight.

name: Havel's Leggings
description: Gear of the giant knight.

description: Gear of the giant knight.

description: Gear of the giant knight.

name: Havel's Old Sword
description: Gear of the giant knight.

name: Havel's Perfectly-Sized Mug
description: A mug, larger than most. It will increase your character's size in battle.

name: Havel's Shield
description: Gear of the giant knight.

entries.name: Bastion III
entries.description: Grants temporary defenses and grants Ward for 5 turns.

name: Havel's Sword
description: Gear of the giant knight.

name: Head of Agathodaemon
description: Head of a Great Dragon, used in Event Crafting at the Monumental Guild Hall during the Wyrmhunt event.

name: Head of Vritra
description: Head of a Great Dragon, used in Event Crafting at the Monumental Guild Hall during the Wyrmhunt event.

name: Head of Zaltys
description: Head of a Great Dragon, used in Event Crafting at the Monumental Guild Hall during the Wyrmhunt event.

name: Heart of Change
description: An Olympian token constructed by the great Undecided. Using it will reverse all ascensions levels earned by your current class, returning all materials, gold, and orns spent to reach that ascension level.

name: Heart of Eos
description:
The Olympians constructed many great Titans to construct their towers to the skies. Few titans remain animated today.

Titan Eos drove a mighty chariot powered by her mighty horses, the Phaethons. She searched the continents for tower materials, never having difficulty delivering them home.

This piece will increase the power of your summons.

name: Heart of Mnemosyne
description:
The Olympians constructed many great Titans to construct their towers to the skies. Few titans remain animated today.

Titan Mnemosyne, mother of Titans and sculptor of memories, puzzles, and labyrinths, protected her kin by misleading adventurers.

name: Heart of Oceanus
description:
The Olympians constructed many great Titans to construct their towers to the skies. Few titans remain animated today.

Oceanus raised the great seas; crashing waves against the towers to test their might. He cooled the artifacts of Prometheus's Kiln, and forced the tower pieces into place with great tidal force.

This augment allows one to break the maximum damage limit.

name: Heart of Prometheus
description:
The Olympians constructed many great Titans to construct their towers to the skies. Few titans remain animated today.

Titan Prometheus operated a great kiln, molding stone, steel, and ortanite needed by the Titans into great pieces of the great towers. Ultimately, it is said his synthetic flesh became a kiln in itself.

This piece increases one's resistance to status effects.

name: Heart of Selene
description:
The Olympians constructed many great Titans to construct their towers to the skies. Few titans remain animated today.

Titan Selene had a certain way with the wildlife surrounding the towers. With the help of the birds, the trees, the hunters, and the prey -- she never felt deficient of help.

This piece will allow your follower to make more intelligent decisions in battle.

name: Heart of Themis
description:
The Olympians constructed many great Titans to construct their towers to the skies. Few titans remain animated today.

Titan Themis, of law and order, balanced the tower planes into place with her shoulders. A plane mustn't lean down to Balor, nor up to skies. A level floor bequeaths the next level floor.

This piece allows one to recover both HP and Mana when taking Ward damage.

name: Heavy Arrows
description: A quiver of arrows that are immensely heavy. Carrying these arrows in your off-hand gives the greater chance to stun an opponent, at the expense of Ward.

entries.name: Volley
entries.description: Deals damage thrice, grants 2 turns of Ward, and may temporarily increase dexterity.

name: Heavy Boots
description: Heavy boots, made to endure most weather conditions.

name: Heimdall's Shield
description: Shield carried by the great Heimdall of the Northern lands. It protects one from the cold.

entries.name: Bastion II
entries.description: Grants temporary defenses and grants Ward for 4 turns.

name: Heka
description:
Osiris, a man unknown to the siblings, fled Aaru not long after Ptah's departure, for he too had grand illusions of power and glory. He travelled West, following what he thought to be Gengen-Wer's trail.

And while he did not find Gengen-Wer, he found plumes of feathers, fallen from the great bird. And where these feathers lay, the power of beasts was awakened.

Kingdoms arose. First Elysium, built upon a rift to the underworld, where Osiris was destined to rule.

And as the wind took the feathers South of here, Nothren was sure to rise.

name: Hel's Boots
description: Footwear of Hel, the shadowed rogue. They grant their wearer additional dexterity and are well suited for adornment.

name: Hel's Feathers
description: Poison tipped arrows of Hel, the shadowed rogue. The quiver offers additional slots for adornment and may protect one via Ward.

entries.name: Volley II
entries.description: Deals damage thrice, grants 2 turns of Ward, and may temporarily increase dexterity.

name: Hel's Garb
description: Light armor of Hel, the shadowed rogue. It grants its wearer additional dexterity and status immunities. Additionally, it is well suited for adornment.

name: Hel's Veil
description: Headwear of Hel, the shadowed rogue. Wearing it may increase one's chance of landing a critical attack.

name: Helhest
description: The mighty bow of Hel. Its loosed arrows will light your path while exploring the world.

name: Hellfire Armor
description: Chapter II: Steadfast and diligent, the Tatzelwurms worked tirelessly to level Lotan's coiled rock. Wearing this armor will improve the relationship between followers and Valhallan classes, allowing them a greater chance to choose the right action for your situation.

description: A robe of a Draconian mage.

description: A decorated flute often used to lull the great Phoenix. Although it seemingly has little power, it is well suited for adornment.

name: Hiltless
description: A curved blade without a hilt. Wielding it may bring harm to oneself, occasionally causing Bloodshift.

name: Hippogriff Eye
description: Eye of a Hippogriff. It increases the power of Apex spells.

name: Hippogriff Quill
description: Piece of a Hippogriff. Perhaps the Monumental Guild can make use of it.

description: Piece of a Hippogriff. Perhaps the Monumental Guild can make use of it.

name: Historic Monster Aspect
description: Aspect of a monster that one may have encountered while traveling these lands. Aspects can be charged simply by walking after being slotted in your Traveler's Guild menu. This aspect will produce Nothren, Lyonesse, or Olympic manifests.

name: Hobgoblin Armor
description: Light armor of a hobgoblin.

name: Hobgoblin Boots
description: Boots of a hobgoblin.

name: Hood
description: A simple hood.

name: Hood of Dynasty
description: Robes of the Great Sphinx, last and corrupted King of Aaru. When wearing this cloth, one is granted access to the skill "Gods of Aaru".

name: Hood of Wolves
description: Hood of a wolfman. Offers decent physical defense.

name: Horned Armor
description: Armor of Cerus, the untamed. It reduces the mana cost of skills or spells and is well suited for adornment.

name: Horned Corinthian Helmet
description: Armor of Centaurus, fallen beast king of Lerna. In an effort to bring Lerna into an age of prosperity, Centaurus looked to the skies for the Celestial might of three Gods in particular. After council, these Gods granted him a fraction of their Celestial power. But Centaurus was of no stature to control this power. Centaurus and a many of the people of Lerna were transformed to strange beasts, akin to the shapes of some stars.

name: Horned Helmet
description: Helmet of Cerus, the untamed. It reduces the mana cost of skills or spells and is well suited for adornment.

name: Horned Hood
description: Hood of Cerus, the untamed. It reduces the mana cost of skills or spells and is well suited for adornment.

name: Horror
description: An incredibly dreadful staff forged of the remains of sunken travelers. It may cause fallen beasts to drop more items.

name: Horseshoes

After council, these Gods granted him a fraction of their Celestial power. But Centaurus was of no stature to control this power. Centaurus and a many of the people of Lerna were transformed to strange beasts, akin to the shapes of some stars.

name: Horus's Robe
description: Ivory robe of Horus, the winged protector of the skies. What it lacks in defensive power is made up with dexterity.

name: Houserobe of Dynasty
description: Robes of the Great Sphinx, last and corrupted King of Aaru. When wearing this cloth, one is granted access to the skill "Gods of Aaru".

name: Huge Empty Bottle
description: A large bottle suitable for holding a brewed potion, tonic, or elixir. Visit a herbalist to fill this bottle.

name: Hurricane Arc
description: A bow signifying the great Griffin of the skies. Arrows shot from this bow can easily knock an opponent off-guard.

name: Hyades Wreath
description: Headwear of the Hyades, ancient songsayers of Terra.

name: Hydra Staff
description: Archistaff forged of the remains of a great Hydra. It can provide one with various elemental resistances.

name: Hymnbook of Destruction

name: Hymnbook of Nature

entries.name: Summon Natureblight II

entries.name: Volley

name: Ichaival
description: Bow of the underworld. It has a good chance of breaking an opponents defenses.

name: Ichor
description: A restorative elixir that removes any stat lowering ailments against you.

name: Ifrit's Feet
description: Boots of an infamous Ifrit of the Inferno Knights. These boots increase the amount of Apex one begins battle with, and allows Apex to charge slightly faster.

name: Imagination
description: An extremely odd staff, carried by a cryptid mimic. It can occasionally cause unpredicted status effects.

name: Immortal Boots
description: Boots of an Immortal warrior. The Immortals are warriors of a great fallen Empire. Their equipment can prevent one from losing their sight.

name: Immortal Garb
description: Light armor of an Immortal warrior. The Immortals are warriors of a great fallen Empire. Their equipment can prevent one from losing their sight.

name: Immortal Hat
description: Infamous headwear of an Immortal warrior. The Immortals are warriors of a great fallen Empire. Their equipment can prevent one from losing their sight.

name: Immortal Hood
description: Hood of an Immortal mage. The Immortals are warriors of a great fallen Empire. Their equipment can prevent one from losing their sight.

name: Immortal Katana
description: The blade of an ageless warrior. It may pierce the defenses of an opponent.

name: Immortal Robe
description: Robe of an Immortal mage. The Immortals are warriors of a great fallen Empire. Their equipment can prevent one from losing their sight.

name: Immortal's Jewel
description: An adornment capable of increasing the HP granted by a piece of equipment when adorned upon it.

name: Immortal's Ring
description: An ageless ring of an Immortal Lord. It grants additional life at the expense of other stats.

name: Imona's Slippers
description: Soft slippers of Imona, waking Goddess of the Fomorian house of Wintara. Imona was blessed with the fortune of a life of unneeded sleep. While wearing this item, buffs cast by its wearer may transfer to a party mate. Additionally, positive status effects will last longer.

name: Incarnate Archistaff
description: Heavy archistaff crafted by Apollyon, the destructive exiled Balor mystic. Apollyon sought to destroy lands to stop the falling, but was exiled for his unorthodox approaches.

name: Incarnate Boots
description: Mystical boots crafted by Apollyon, the destructive exiled Balor mystic. Apollyon sought to destroy lands to stop the falling, but was exiled for his unorthodox approaches.

name: Incarnate Hood
description: Mystical hood crafted by Apollyon, the destructive exiled Balor mystic. Apollyon sought to destroy lands to stop the falling, but was exiled for his unorthodox approaches.

name: Incarnate Robe

name: Infernal Boots
description: Great boots of a mage who controlled the heat. Grants protection from fire.

name: Iron

name: Iron Armor
description: Heavy armor made of iron.

name: Iron Hammer
description: A large hammer suitable for crushing blows.

name: Iron Helmet
description: An old iron helmet.

name: Iron Ring
description: A standard ring. You feel slightly stronger while wearing it. Slightly raises defense.

name: Iron Shield
description: A simple shield of iron.

name: Ithra's Blade
description: Thin, cold blade of Ithra, the White Knight. Ithra established the Frozenguard to combat the Draconian invasion.

name: Ithra's Staff
description: Thin, cold staff of Ithra, the White Knight. Ithra established the Frozenguard to combat the Draconian invasion.

name: Jewel of Arcana

name: Jewel of Attrition

name: Jewel of Avalon

name: Jewel of Celestria
description: A small adornment of the stars capable of increasing the magical power of a piece of equipment when adorned upon it.

name: Jewel of Creation
description: Chapter XI: As the sky formed over this new land, the powers of these Great Dragons combined to form the Ymir Amphiptere. The Ymir Amphiptere created the night sky and brought weather to the lands.

name: Jewel of Defense

name: Jewel of Destruction

name: Jewel of Fira

name: Jewel of Fomoria

name: Jewel of Growth

name: Jewel of Resistance

name: Jewel of Silencing

name: Jewel of Sparring

name: Jewel of Speed

Centaurus and a many of the people of Lerna were transformed to strange beasts, akin to the shapes of some stars.

name: Nekhakha
description:
Osiris, a man unknown to the siblings, fled Aaru not long after Ptah's departure, for he too had grand illusions of power and glory. He travelled West, following what he thought to be Gengen-Wer's trail.

And while he did not find Gengen-Wer, he found plumes of feathers, fallen from the great bird. And where these feathers lay, the power of beasts was awakened.

Kingdoms arose. First Elysium, built upon a rift to the underworld, where Osiris was destined to rule.

And as the wind took the feathers South of here, Nothren was sure to rise.

name: Polished Mirror

entries.name: Reflect
entries.description: Grants a chance to return a portion of an opponent's attack back at them. Reflections are more successful when magic users attempt them.

description: Azure greataxe of Pollux, the Dioscuri berserker. Pollux and his twin brother seldomly leave the depths of the seas unless truly lacking in other hobbies.

name: Proof of Torment

name: Proof of Trials

name: Proof of Undying Allegiance
description: An item issued by a Guild when one has reached ultimate allegiance. Upon using this item, experience, orns, gold, and many other rewards will be greatly increased for 48 hours.

name: Realm Boots
description: Light armor crafted by Apollyon, the destructive exiled Balor mystic. Apollyon sought to destroy lands to stop the falling, but was exiled for his unorthodox approaches.

name: Realm Katar

entries.name: Counterattack
entries.description: Grants a chance to return a portion of an opponent's attack back at them. Counterattacks are favorable to win in PvP draws.

name: Realmcrystal
description: An oddly shaped crystal fallen from Olympia. Using it will allow one to return to another Realm without wait.

name: Realmspikes

name: Reaper's Scythe
description: The followers of Ankou are fearsome, and this great scythe is their chosen weapon. It has a high chance of causing an opponent to bleed.

name: Reaping Sickle
description: The followers of Apollyon are fearsome, and this great scythe is their chosen weapon. It has a high chance of causing an opponent to bleed.

name: Red Pinion

description: A blade of the spellsword.

name: Sabrina's Cowl
description: Headwear of Sabrina, river Goddess of the Fomorian house of Autumna. Sabrina and her sisters traversed the riverways, tunnels, and creeks to get the edge in battle, but Morrigan's forces were far too plentiful. While wearing this item, debuffs will be easier to cast on your opponent. Additionally, it increases the maximum damage of status effects on your opponent.

name: Salmon of Knowledge
description: A salmon containing most, if not all, of the world's knowledge. The scent may draw extra monsters to you during Horde Mode dungeons, which may also have contributed to Oillipheist's stench.

name: Sand Mortar
description: Each Titan preferred working with a type of mortar. When applied to a weapon, Atlas's preferred mortar increases collateral damage.

name: Sandstone
description: Material made of hardened sand. Useful for upgrading powerful weapons.

name: Sandstorm
description: A rare scimitar of the sands. Slightly increases gold earned.

name: Sanguine Archistaff
description: A large staff wielded by kobold lords.

name: Sanguine Staff
description: A simple staff wielded by kobold mages.

name: Sanguine Sword
description: A simple sword wielded by kobold warriors.

name: Sarbacane
description: A deadly weapon constructed with the finest of materials and stuffed with toxic flora. This weapon carries more than darts; it carries disease itself. Each breath releases a virulent toxin said to be drawn from the deepest roots of the wild, where even the air festers. Those struck do not simply fall...They wither.

entries.name: Toxic Dart
entries.description: A vicious dart that uses either your attack or magic stat, and applies Toxic, Poison, Rot, and Blight.

name: Satis
description: Bow of Thronemaker Sekhmet. When holding this weapon, one will often be granted temporary dexterity or critical strike chance in battle.

name: Satis Antlers
description: This unique headwear does not offer much protection, but is well suited for adornment.

name: Saturn's Eye
description: A celestial adornment capable of increasing many attributes of a piece of equipment when adorned upon it.

name: Scalestone

description: A rare amulet, forged of the remains of a Kheper.

description: A short sword with a curved blade, designed for horseback combat.

name: Scorcher
description: This sword of the Inferno Knights is eternally ablaze.

entries.name: Read Scroll
entries.description: Slightly restores mana.

name: Scroll of Anguish

name: Scroll of Arisen Rift Distortion
description: A scroll containing mixed incantations of Riftfall. Use at your own risk.

name: Scroll of Chaos
description:
A scroll containing a terrible incantation that will turn the world magenta. For one hour, this scroll will increase the chance of encountering rare monsters or those belonging to an active World Event. Less monsters will be encountered and more monsters may spawn berserk.

For T6+ players, Community Raid Events may also be found when exploring your world.

name: Scroll of Crimson Chaos
description:
A scroll containing stories of Lerna's Crimson Festival. Reading it will bring these stories to life, enveloping your world in chaos and greatly increasing the chances of encountering monsters belonging to the Crimson Festival world event. This item may only be used during the Crimson Festival.

For T6+ players, Community Raid Events of the Crimson Festival's celestial Gods may also be found when exploring your world.

description: A piece of literature crafted by the Monumental Guild. It recalls the story of the Great Sphinx, and will summon a projection of it when read.

name: Scroll of Earth
description: A scroll containing knowledge of earthen. It improves one's magic and the charge rate of Manaflasks, while adding a chance to rot to spells.

entries.name: Read Scroll
entries.description: Slightly restores mana.

name: Scroll of Fey Jormungandr
description: A scroll containing the incantations of Ragnarok. Reading them will summon Fey Jormungandr.

name: Scroll of Fire

entries.name: Read Scroll
entries.description: Slightly restores mana.

entries.description: Slightly restores mana.

description: A scroll containing the incantations of Ragnarok. Reading them will summon Jormungandr.
