entries.description: Slightly restores mana.

name: Scroll of Rift Distortion
description: A scroll containing mixed incantations of Riftfall. Use at your own risk.

name: Scroll of the Judges Trifecta
description: A scroll consisting of Elysian lore. Read this scroll to summon the Judge Trifecta Maximus super raid to your location.

name: Scroll of the Sapling
description: A scroll consisting of the lore of the great Yggdrasil's saplings. Read this scroll to summon a Sapling of Yggdrasil to your location.

name: Scroll of Yggdrasil
description: A scroll consisting of the lore of the great Yggdrasil. Read this scroll to summon the Yggdrasil super raid to your location.

name: Scythe
description: A large tool quite suitable for cutting grass.

name: Sea Axe
description: An axe enchanted with the power of the raging sea. It greatly increases the chance of dealing collateral damage.

name: Sea Bass
description: A medium sized fish, often seen in larger bodies of water.

name: Second Horseman's Armor
description: Armor of the Second Horseman, often associated with great pestilence. It reduces the damage taken from the ultimate attacks of Raid Bosses.

name: Second Horseman's Boots
description: Boots of the Second Horseman, often associated with great pestilence. It reduces the damage taken from the ultimate attacks of Raid Bosses.

name: Second Horseman's Cloak
description: Cloak of the Second Horseman, often associated with great pestilence. It reduces the damage taken from the ultimate attacks of Raid Bosses.

name: Second Horseman's Hood
description: Hood of the Second Horseman, often associated with great pestilence. It reduces the damage taken from the ultimate attacks of Raid Bosses.

name: Second Horseman's Staff
description: Staff of the Second Horseman, often associated with great pestilence. It reduces the damage taken from the ultimate attacks of Raid Bosses and can cause an opponent to be poisoned or blighted.

name: Seed of Yggdrasil
description: Seed of the great tree, Yggdrasil. This item is part of the Ragnarok world event.

name: Seeker's Candle
description: When lit, this candle is said to draw near monsters that you have accepted a quest for. This item lasts 1 hour.

name: Sempre Forte
description: A relic of Apollyon's less destructive years.

name: Sequana's Chestpiece
description: Masterly smithed chest armor of Sequana, river Goddess and leader of the Fomorian house of Autumna. The oldest of her sisters, Sequana was a deity of grace and fortune. While wearing this item, debuffs will be easier to cast on your opponent. Additionally, it increases the maximum damage of status effects on your opponent.
effects: Status Effect Chance: +20% / Status Effect Duration: +1 turn

name: Serpent Arrows
description: A package of arrows carried by Medusa. They offer a greater chance to poison an opponent.

entries.name: Poison Volley
entries.description: Deals damage thrice and may poison an opponent.

name: Serpent Pearl
description:
Charm of a fallen King, Ulster. Ulster was King of the Seas but was poisoned by his own herbalist, Mori.

While holding this item, some your Defense and Resistance stats will be swapped. The better the quality of this item, the bigger amount of your Defense and Resistance stats will be exchanged.

name: Serpentslayer's Chestplate
description: Chestplate of Perseus. It increases your ability to resist negative status effects.

name: Serpentslayer's Cowl
description: Headwear of Perseus. It increases your ability to resist negative status effects.

name: Serpentslayer's Legwear
description: Legwear of Perseus. It increases your ability to resist negative status effects.

name: Settler's Crownguard
description: A simple Crownguard for use by the Conqueror's Guild. Crownguards provide your character with added power when defending Settlements from other players. They may also prevent NPCs of the Conqueror's Guild from challenging you for your Settlements. This Crownguard will give you a slight power boost for 6 hours.

name: Severause's Cabochon
description: A polished gem often adorned upon Arthus's knights' weapons.

name: Severause's Halberd
description: Halberd of Sir Severause, fallen Knight of Arthus's Round Table. Sir Severause preferred fighting a rare beast to a human, and often dismissed his knightly duties to pursue many a beast.

entries.name: Halberd Sweep
entries.description: Deals physical damage to all opponents with a chance to break their defenses.

name: Shadow Boots
description: Dark armor of elite Balor rogues.

name: Shadow Garb
description: Dark armor of elite Balor rogues.

name: Shadow Hood
description: Dark armor of elite Balor rogues.

name: Shadow Katana
description: A thin, pale blade granted to elite Balor warriors.

name: Shaman's Charm
description: An amulet carried by most talented of healers. Wearing this item will increase the effectiveness of healing items.

name: Sharpened Kerberos Claws
description: Sharp, jagged blades forged of the mighty claws of Kerberos. They can cause an opponent to bleed or become frozen.

name: Shiva's Bow
description: A decorative bow enchanted with the power of ice. It can easily cause an opponent to freeze.

name: Short Sword
description: A trusty, yet short, sword.

name: Shoulders of Eos
description: A piece of a Titan themself. These pieces can be used to augment celestial weapons at a Titan Workshop. This piece will allow your summons to protect you more frequently.

name: Shoulders of Mnemosyne
description: Titan Mnemosyne, mother of Titans and sculptor of memories, puzzles, and labyrinths, protected her kin by misleading adventurers.

name: Shoulders of Oceanus
description: A piece of a Titan themself. These pieces can be used to augment celestial weapons at a Titan Workshop.

name: Shoulders of Prometheus
description: A piece of a Titan themself. These pieces can be used to augment celestial weapons at a Titan Workshop.

name: Shoulders of Selene
description: A piece of a Titan themself. These pieces can be used to augment celestial weapons at a Titan Workshop. This piece will increase frequency that your follower will act in battle.

name: Shoulders of Themis
description: A piece of a Titan themself. These pieces can be used to augment celestial weapons at a Titan Workshop. This augment will increase the amount of damage dealt with Holy attacks and spells.

name: Side-arm
description: A small dagger, carried in your off-hand. It slightly increases attack at the expense of Ward.

entries.name: Parry
entries.description: Wait one turn, then return an opponent's attack back at them.

name: Sigma Olympia Archistaff
description: Rare weapon, fallen from an Olympian.

name: Silk Crossbow
description: A sturdy crossbow fastened with a thread of strong silk.

name: Silphium
description: A sprig of silphium. It is useful in crafting some potions at a herbalist.

name: Silver

name: Silver Amulet
description: A shiny, silver amulet. Raises attack power.

name: Silver Crossbow
description: A silver crossbow especially effective against the undead.

name: Silver Dagger
description: A silver dagger. Quite suitable when fighting the undead.

name: Silver Half Locket
description: A half of a locket, once worn by someone close to Mara.

name: Silver Kris
description: Two sharp daggers made of the finest of silver. Useful for hunting the undead.

entries.description: Swiftly attack twice, dealing up to double damage.

name: Silver Medal
description: Medal awarded in the Sumner Games, a storied event of Olympia.

name: Simple Robe

name: Simple Shoes
description: A simple pair of trusty shoes.

description: Legwear of Yggdrasil, the fallen symbol of life.

name: Sleighblade
description: A glistening sword carried by followers of Scruug. It is quite chilling to the touch. When using this weapon, you will start battle with Ward automatically activated.

name: Small Bestial Potion
description: A sweet and nutritious tonic. Having your follower consume it will increase their action rate for a limited time.

description: A small bottle suitable for holding a brewed potion, tonic, or elixir. Visit a herbalist to fill this bottle.

description: Recovers 100 health points.

name: Small Mana Potion
description: Recovers 100 mana.

description: A mushroom of Naggeneen's collection. Eating it will cause one to enrage, but become afflicted with Toxic.

name: Smelly Shoes
description: Foul shoes worn by the fairy Naggeneen. Oddly, they can protect their wearer from poison and blight.

description: Armor made of great snake's remains.

description: A cowl made of great snake's remains.

description: Light armor imbued with celestial might.

description: A scroll of destructive solar magic crafted by Emile. Using it will grant the skills "Solarstrikes" and "Solarseals".

name: Solarite
description: Rare chunk of solarite. Useful in upgrading powerful equipment.

name: Solarite Mortar
description: Each Titan preferred working with a type of mortar. When applied to a weapon, Asteria's preferred mortar increases damage dealt with weapons that require both hands.

name: Songbook of Nature
description: Old Grimoire of Terra, allowing one to summon Terra's beasts.

name: Soul Blade
description: Ceremonial blade of a long forgotten civilization. It has a small chance of cursing an opponent.

name: Soul of Achlys
description: Soul of Achlys, the Red Dagger. Adorning this soul within your weapon will increase light and dark damage.

entries.name: Shade of Achlys, the Red Dagger

name: Soul of Charon
description: Soul of Charon, the Grand Summoner. Adorning this soul within your weapon will slightly increase the power of your summons.

name: Soul of Rhada
description: Soul of Rhada, the Great Shield. Adorning this soul within your armor will decrease light and dark damage taken.

entries.name: Shade of Rhada, the Great Shield

name: Sour Mushroom
description: A mushroom of Naggeneen's collection. Eating it will greatly increase one's attack and magic powers, but become afflicted with a variety of illnesses.

name: Spear
description: A blade fashioned upon an extended shaft of wood.

name: Spectral Armor
description: A piece threaded of distant memories. Memories of the famed, yet feared, "Angel" of destruction. In his youth, Apollyon favored vitality and dexterity over orthodox defenses.

description: A sour tonic that raises your speed in battle.

description: A strange magical ring. Those who are not trained in magical arts can equip this ring to sacrifice physical strength for magic power.

name: Spelunking Staff
description: Staff of a lost dungeon explorer. It seems to have developed quite some power while resting deep within the land.

name: Spiked Greatshield
description: Spiked shield of Judge Rhada. When using this shield, skills that consume Ward will be more effective.

entries.name: Tower of Strength
entries.description: Recovers Ward. Requires 2 turns in battle.

name: Spinal Whip
description:
He lifts his head as though to bow,
And tips it gently, here and now.
No crown of gold, no jeweled delight,
Just grinning teeth in ghostly white.

description: Book carried by Fenja, the Nothren summoner. It can call a famed Nothren wolf into battle.

entries.name: Summon Spiritgarm
entries.description: Summon an animal to assist you. Requires 2 turns in battle.

name: Spoiled Dioscuri Mead
description: Consume with caution.

description: A spore of a toxic mushroom. Adorning it upon a weapon can add a variety of status effects to your attacks.

name: Staff
description: A mage's staff.

name: Staff of the Chimera
description: A powerful staff forged of the remains of a Chimera. Using this weapon may cause one to fill with immense rage, inflicting the Berserk status.

name: Staff of Tiamat
description: A superb staff forged of the remains of Tiamat, the great ancient dragon.

name: Staff of Typhon
description: A superb staff forged of the remains of Typhon, the great ancient dragon.

name: Staff of Wolves
description: Staff of a wolfman mage. Imbued with earthen powers.

name: Staff of Zaltys
description: Chapter V: Zaltys never did like the Agathodaemon, but understood that she needed the soil for life. Zaltys laid seed to the soil, sprouting the foliage that lets us breath our air. Her staff represents life, and will allow you to recover HP each turn in battle.

name: Stardust
description: A celestial adornment capable of increasing many attributes of a piece of equipment when adorned upon it.

name: Steadfast Charm
description: A yellow crystal carried by some of the most steadfast. Carrying this item may occasionally protect you from status effects.

name: Steady Hands of Eos
description: A piece of a Titan themself. These pieces can be used to augment celestial weapons at a Titan Workshop.

name: Steady Hands of Prometheus
description: A piece of a Titan themself. These pieces can be used to augment celestial weapons at a Titan Workshop. This piece will increase the power of critical hits.

name: Steady Hands of Selene
description: A piece of a Titan themself. These pieces can be used to augment celestial weapons at a Titan Workshop.

name: Steady Pendant
description: A sturdy pendant often worn by centurions. It protects its wearer from being stunned.

name: Steel
description: A small piece of steel ore. Useful for crafting and upgrading weapons or armor.

name: Steel Armor
description: Armor made of hard steel.

name: Steel Belt
description: A belt fashioned with steel. Improves your dexterity and defense.

name: Steel Leggings
description: Armor made of hard steel.

name: Steel Ring
description: A ring made of steel. Raises defense when worn.

name: Steelguard
description: A sword and shield pairing made of hardened steel.

description: A candle gifted by Damra as part of the Steward ritual. Light it to summon your Steward.

name: Stilettos
description: A pair of unnecessarily sharp daggers. These will easily cause an opponent to bleed.

entries.description: Swiftly attack twice, dealing up to double damage.

name: Stone Cure
description: A simple tonic that cures one of petrification.

name: Stone Dagger
description: A dagger, once a fixture upon a noble statue. It has a small chance of petrifying an opponent.

name: Stone Pendant
description: A pendant often worn against the mighty cockatrice. It protects its wearer from petrification.

name: Stonewarg Grimoire
description: Book carried by Fenja, the Nothren summoner. It can call a famed Nothren wolf into battle.

entries.name: Summon Stonewarg
entries.description: Summon an animal to assist you. Requires 2 turns in battle.

name: Storm Arrows
description: A quiver of arrows that charged with the power of the sky. Carrying these arrows in your off-hand gives the chance to paralyze an opponent, at the expense of Ward.

entries.name: Volley
entries.description: Deals damage thrice, grants 2 turns of Ward, and may temporarily increase dexterity.

name: Storm Belt
description: Belt of Stormforce. Grants protection from lightning.

name: Storm Sceptre
description: A staff that harnesses the power lurking above the wielder.

name: Stranger's Gift
description: A gift for another. Open it to find out what it could be.

name: Strong Fishing Line
description: A stronger fishing line, suitable for fetching aught from the seas. Use when near a body of water or fountain to begin fishing.

name: Sturdy Feet of Eos
description: A piece of a Titan themself. These pieces can be used to augment celestial weapons at a Titan Workshop. This piece allows one to occasionally summon beasts in one less turn.

name: Sturdy Feet of Prometheus
description: A piece of a Titan themself. These pieces can be used to augment celestial weapons at a Titan Workshop. This piece allows one to recover Ward with each turn.

name: Sturdy Feet of Selene
description: A piece of a Titan themself. These pieces can be used to augment celestial weapons at a Titan Workshop.

name: Sturdy Feet of Themis
description: A piece of a Titan themself. These pieces can be used to augment celestial weapons at a Titan Workshop. This piece allows one to take reduced damage when defending in battle.

name: Succubus Mantle
description: Crude armor made of the remains of a succubus. Does not offer much defense, but raises your dexterity.

name: Summoner's Hood
description: Hood worn by advanced summoners. When wearing this hood, using pacts with your summons will be more effective.

name: Summoner's Robe
description: Robe worn by advanced summoners. It increases the chance of a summon protecting you in battle.

name: Summoner's Shoes
description: Shoes worn by advanced summoners. They slightly increase the power of summoned beasts.

name: Summoning Scroll
description: A scroll containing the ancient Balor techniques of the summon. Reading it will summon a powerful Raid Boss to your nearby area.

name: Summoning Scroll of Merlin
description: A scroll containing the knowledge of Merlin himself. Using this scroll will summon a Merlin world raid to your location.

name: Sumner Crested Shield
description: Shield of Fomor, Cursed King of Fomoria. This item grants a number of passive abilities known to be utilized by the Fomorian houses.

name: Sun Boots
description: Magic attire imbued with solar energy.

name: Sun Hat
description: Magic attire imbued with solar energy.

name: Sun Robe
description: Magic attire imbued with solar energy.

name: Sun Staff
description: A staff imbued with celestial might.

name: Super Elixir
description: Recovers 2500 health points and 1000 mana.

name: Super Empty Bottle
description: A large bottle suitable for holding a brewed potion, tonic, or elixir. Visit a herbalist to fill this bottle.

name: Super EXP Potion
description: A sour tasting elixir that quadruples experience earned for 1 hour.

name: Super Farsight
description: A tonic that improves eyesight. Consuming this item will increase your view distance for 1 hour.

name: Super Health Potion
description: Recovers 2500 health points.

name: Super Mana Potion
description: Recovers 2500 mana.

name: Surtr's Boots
description: Footwear of Surtr, the wanderer. They grant their wearer additional dexterity and are well suited for adornment.

name: Surtr's Cuirass
description: Light armor of Surtr, the wanderer. It grants its wearer additional Ward and is well suited for adornment.

name: Surtr's Helmet
description: Helmet of Surtr, the wanderer. It grants its wearer additional HP and is well suited for adornment.

name: Surtr's Shield
description: Decorated shield of Surtr, the Southern wanderer. It increases defense and resistance at the expense of Ward.

entries.name: Bastion II
entries.description: Grants temporary defenses and grants Ward for 4 turns.

name: Surtr's Sword
description: The extremely bright, decorative sword of Surtr. It can easily blind an opponent and will draw more monsters towards you with its bright, everlasting light.

name: Svargan Fishing Line
description: A very strong fishing line, suitable for fetching aught from the seas. Use when near a body of water or fountain to begin fishing.

name: Swansong
description: Golden harp of Medea.

entries.name: Swansong
entries.description: Use both your magic and attack stats to cast the famous song of the Swansong.

name: Sword and Shield
description: A simple sword and shield.

name: Symbol of Doom
description: Adornment of the Final Horseman. Adorning it upon a weapon will increase the action rate and stats of your follower.

name: Symbol of Famine
description: Adornment of the First Horseman. Adorning it upon a piece of armor will slightly protect one from status ailments.

name: Symbol of Pestilence
description: Adornment of the Second Horseman. Adorning it upon a piece of armor will moderately protect one from status ailments.

name: Symbol of War
description: Adornment of the Third Horseman. Adorning it upon a weapon will increase the distance that you can see.

name: Tablet of Hyperion
description: A stone tablet recovered by the Monumental Guild. It recalls the story of Hyperion, a great Titan.

name: Tail of a Sphinx
description: Cut tail of a beast of Aaru. Surely he will grow another. When carrying this item, one's thirst for the ornate will deepen, allowing items of higher quality to be found ever so slightly more often.

name: Taranis Hood
description: Hood of an infamous Taranis of Stormforce. This hood increases the amount of Apex one begins battle with, and allows Apex to charge slightly faster.

name: Tarnished King's Crown
description: The broken crown of forgotten King Meliodas. Meliodas claimed rule after Gradlon had fallen, but many outright deny his kingship. Its dents and cracks make it well suited for adornment.

name: Tattered Clothwrap
description: A simple piece of cloth. It's quite old and musty.

name: Tempest Boots
description: Great boots of a mage who controlled the skies. Grants protection from lightning.

name: Templar Shield
description: The shield of a mighty templar knight. It provides extra physical defense.

name: Temporal Monster Aspect
description: Aspect of a monster that one may have encountered while traveling these lands. Aspects can be charged simply by walking after being slotted in your Traveler's Guild menu. Fully charged Aspects are converted into Manifestations for use in Guild Trials. This aspect will produce manifest of event monsters.

name: Terra Boots
description: Great boots of a mage who controlled the ground below. Grants protection from earthen magic.

name: Terra's Bracer
description:
Bracer worn by the people of Terra as they started the late process of Emerald Restoration.

Replacing the Dark with Light Elm rejuvenates the planet and self, allowing one to restore mana on each turn in battle.

This armor will increase the damage of Ward based skilled when using the Frenzy ability.
effects: Damage Protect: 100% Max HP Damage (25% chance)

description: Coat reminiscent of the formidable Yeti. It protects one from the snow and from having their defenses lowered.

name: Yggdrasil Crucible
description: An crucible holding the remains of Yggdrasil. Use it upon an Anguished item to receive a bonus unique to this item.

name: Ymir Agathodaemon Hammer
description: Chapter IV: The Agathodaemon, destructive as always, crumbled the tops of the coiled stone into earth and soil. He layed this soil over Vritra's wings, forming the ground as we know it. The Agathodaemon's hammer can crush the Ward of your opponent.

entries.name: Crush
entries.description: Deals damage and may stun an opponent. Additionally, it may hit an additional opponent.

name: Ymir Beithir's Staff
description: Aside: As Illuyanka's walls were raised, protection for this new land was needed. Beithir, with the breath of lightning and claws of toxin, replicated itself indefinitely. An army of Dragons was created in an instant.

entries.name: Summon Beithir II
entries.description: Summon great beasts to assist you. Requires 3 turns in battle.

name: Ymir Brilliant Feathers
description: Chapter IX: Quetzalcoatl flew high, shedding her feathers in the air. As the sun melted her feathers, they filled the craters Bashe left behind, forming our lakes and rivers. Her remaining feathers form this scythe, and it will better align you with your faction's might.

entries.name: Slice
entries.description: Deals damage and may cause bleeding. Additionally, it may hit an additional opponent.

name: Ymir Cliffside Cuirass
description: Chapter VI: Illuyanka then raised walls of stone to frame this new land from the raging seas and winds. The cliffs and shores can be seen from afar, and her mighty armor will surely make one feel as they are made of the cliffs themselves. It will occasionally protect you from hits that take 100% of your maximum HP.
effects: Damage Protect: 100% Max HP Damage (25% chance)

name: Ymir Coiled Shield
description: Chapter I: These lands were created by the Great Dragons: 8 deities formed by the wants and wishes of humankind. Lotan was the first to mend the earth, coiling rock from the planet's core to create the foundation of life. Her shield will greatly decrease the damage taken when defending in battle.

entries.name: Bastion
entries.description: Grants temporary defenses and grants Ward for 3 turns.

name: Ymir Staff of Zaltys
description: Chapter V: Zaltys never did like the Agathodaemon, but understood that she needed the soil for life. Zaltys laid seed to the soil, sprouting the foliage that lets us breath our air. Her staff represents life, and will allow you to recover HP each turn in battle.

name: Ymir Vritra Charm
description: Chapter III: Vritra was next to forge these lands, laying her immutable wings upon the coiled rock. This formed a basin of strength for life to grow atop the molten core of this planet. Her charm may occasionally protect you from status effects while granting immunity to Paralyze, Stun, and Petrification.

name: Ymir World Eater
description: Chapter VIII: Bashe, the World Eater -- hungry as ever -- drove his mouth downwards, piercing the foundation of the Agathodaemon. His broadsword is filled with craters as well, making it well suitable for adornment.

name: Yokai's Staff
description: A staff of the revered Yokai. It may lower an opponent's magical defenses.

name: Zagreus Bident
description: Weapon of Zagreus, fallen Judge of Elysium. Zagreus carried two items -- one polearm and one net.

name: Zagreus Chestplate
description: Gear of Zagreus, fallen Judge of Elysium. Zagreus was once a Judge of Elysium, but was later banished to the Dark Rift. His followers followed him to the Underworld below.
